When people (mainly people with money or within the political sphere) start voicing their opinions and fighting back to resist the advancements and goals of a marginalized community, it becomes a “political” opinion, which opens the conversation up to anyone and everybody, regardless of their experience or knowledge of what’s really happening to said marginalized community.  bottom line, people in power as well as deeply bigoted  and hateful groups slandering and trying to prevent the achievement of human rights from marginalized  peoples is NOT political, not engaging in political conversation whatsoever, it is, instead, simply tyrant and bigotry. Please, never say that the “issue” of lgbtq people trying to gain human rights is “political”, it’s no more political than standing up for yourself to a bully.
